name: thomas test
description: A hip flexor length test where you lie on the edge of a bench and see how freely the thigh hangs.
instructions: Sit at the end of a bench, then lie back and hug one knee to your chest.
Let the other leg hang off the edge with the thigh relaxed.
Keep your lower back flat on the bench.
Notice whether the hanging thigh rises above the bench or the knee straightens.
